name: tlvdemux
description: ARIB MMT/TLV demultiplexer for browsers, workers, and Node.js

scripts.build:wasm: emcmake cmake -S . -B build-wasm -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DTLVDEMUX_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DTLVDEMUX_USE_SYSTEM_LIBARIBTLV=OFF -DTLVDEMUX_LIBARIBTLV_SOURCE_DIR= && cmake --build build-wasm --target tlvdemux-wasm
scripts.build:package: cmake -E make_directory dist && cmake -E copy_if_different build-wasm/tlvdemux.js dist/tlvdemux.js
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:package
scripts.test: node tests/live_stream_coalescing.mjs && node tests/mse_append_queue.mjs && node tests/mse_gap_recovery.mjs && node tests/worker_result_value.mjs && node tests/worker_track_selection.mjs && node tests/asset_group_selection.mjs && node tests/subtitle_track_selection.mjs && node tests/wasm_smoke.mjs dist/tlvdemux.js
